---
title: "日報"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
import os
from pathlib import Path

# Get reports directory
reports_dir = Path("assets/reports")

# Get all date folders (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
date_dirs = sorted([d for d in reports_dir.iterdir() 
                   if d.is_dir() and len(d.name) == 10 and d.name[4] == '-' and d.name[7] == '-'],
                  reverse=True)

# Find latest report
latest_date = None
if date_dirs:
    latest_date = date_dirs[0].name
```

## 最新報告

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if latest_date:
    zh_pdf = f"assets/reports/{latest_date}/financial_report_zh.pdf"
    print(f"**報告日期：{latest_date}**\n")
else:
    print("暫無最新報告")
```

## 過往報告

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
if date_dirs:
    print("| 日期 | 中文版 | 英文版 |")
    print("|------|--------|--------|")
    for date_dir in date_dirs[:30]:
        date = date_dir.name
        zh_exists = (date_dir / "financial_report_zh.pdf").exists()
        en_exists = (date_dir / "financial_report_en.pdf").exists()
        
        zh_link = f"[📥 下載]({date}/financial_report_zh.pdf)" if zh_exists else "—"
        en_link = f"[📥 下載]({date}/financial_report_en.pdf)" if en_exists else "—"
        
        # Fix path for table
        zh_link = zh_link.replace("{date}", f"assets/reports/{date}")
        en_link = en_link.replace("{date}", f"assets/reports/{date}")
        
        print(f"| {date} | {zh_link} | {en_link} |")
```
